newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end steady, seen firm.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end steady, seen firm.

text.p: Pakistani money rates remained high on Wednesday amid tight liquidity and dealers said rates might firm on a special open market operation on Thursday.
The overnight rate was steady at 20 percent in dull trading.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan sold six-month bonds worth 500 million rupees in its weekly open market operation at a cut-off yield of 16.75 percent a year, one dealer said.
An inflow of about 11 billion rupees was expected on Thursday on maturity of an earlier OMO but rates might stay high as the market was about 18.5 billion rupees short, he said.
